rows.it: Il segnale raffigurato vieta il transito a tutti gli autoveicoli

en.current: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all motor vehicles
en.proposed: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all vehicles in the autoveicoli category

zh-Hans.current: 图中所示标志禁止所有机动车通行
zh-Hans.proposed: 图中所示标志禁止所有汽车类车辆（autoveicoli）通行

es-419.current: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de motor
es-419.proposed: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de la categoría autoveicoli

evidence.support: Art. 54(1) defines autoveicoli as motor vehicles of at least four wheels, excluding motoveicoli; its classes include cars, buses and trucks.
Art. 53 classifies motoveicoli separately, including two-wheeled motorcycles, three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.
Art. 52 defines ciclomotori as motor vehicles; hence a general term for all motor vehicles also includes vehicles outside autoveicoli.
DPR 495/1992 art. 117(1)(g): sign II.58 prohibits all autoveicoli, including three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.

rows.reason: The current broad term includes motorcycles and mopeds outside the Italian autoveicoli class. The proposed wording preserves the category and the quantifier without adding a sign-specific rule; 25777 still asserts an end to a prohibition and remains false.
rows.ambiguity: Autoveicoli is an Italian legal category without an exact everyday equivalent across these languages; retaining the Italian term requires a learner-facing definition in independently reviewed explanations. In Chinese 汽车类车辆 is an approximate label, qualified by the original term. Sign II.58 separately extends its prohibition to three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles; that sign scope is not a redefinition of autoveicoli in the question.
